name: dust_positions
description: Threat T22 (dust positions) made quantitative. A tiny position (0.01 ETH of collateral) is opened at the max-LTV limit and a liquidator only acts when the debt is worth at least 25 USD (a stand-in for the gas cost of a liquidation call). What fraction of the windows end with an unhealthy position that nobody liquidates ('stuck')? The protocol has NO minimum borrow size in v1, which is why this is documented as not mitigated.
